target.title: docs: repair ClawHub docs navigation
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Resolves a docs navigation problem where the ClawHub tab pointed to several pages that are not present in the repository, and legacy ClawHub redirects pointed at `/clawhub` even though no ClawHub landing page existed.

AI-assisted.

## Why This Change Was Made

Adds a small ClawHub landing page that links to the existing CLI and publishing docs, trims the ClawHub nav to routes that exist, adds the required zh-CN glossary labels for the new ClawHub links, and regenerates the docs map so route metadata stays current.

## User Impact

Readers can open the ClawHub docs hub and navigate to the available ClawHub docs without hitting missing docs routes.

## Evidence

- `pnpm docs:map:gen` - passed; updated `docs/docs_map.md`.
- Custom docs nav route validator for `docs/docs.json` pages and redirects - passed with `missing=0`.
- `pnpm docs:check-mdx` - passed: 705 files checked.
- `pnpm docs:check-links` - passed: 5,782 internal links checked, 0 broken links.
- `pnpm docs:map:check` - passed: docs map is up to date.
- `node_modules\.bin\oxfmt.cmd --write --threads=1 --config .oxfmtrc.jsonc docs\clawhub\index.md` - passed.
- `pnpm dlx --config.resolution-mode=highest markdownlint-cli2 --config config/markdownlint-cli2.jsonc --no-globs docs/clawhub/index.md` - passed: 0 errors.
- `node scripts/check-docs-i18n-glossary.mjs --base origin/main --head HEAD` - passed.
- `pnpm docs:check-i18n-glossary` - passed.
- `node -e "JSON.parse(require('node:fs').readFileSync('docs/.i18n/glossary.zh-CN.json','utf8')); console.log('json ok')"` - passed.
- `git diff --check` - passed.

`pnpm check:docs` was also attempted, but the repo's full docs formatter hit a Windows command-line length failure before content checks ran (`The command line is too long` from `scripts/format-docs.mjs`). The underlying MDX, link, docs map, targeted format, targeted lint, glossary, and JSON checks above passed.
